frequency_question: What proportion of executive trade penalty implementations complete all mandatory regulatory drafting, interagency review, and customs system updates within 120 days of initial announcement?
membership_rule: Includes all executive actions announcing sudden tariff rate changes requiring federal register publication, customs automated commercial environment (ACE) programming, and port enforcement instructions. Excludes purely statutory legislative tariffs.
coverage_note: 6 named major tariff implementation processes evaluated for sub-120-day execution from announcement to effective date.
known_gaps: Historical variance in emergency vs standard regulatory processing speeds.
skeleton: Executive actions requiring Federal Register publication, interagency review under USTR/Treasury, and CBP system reprogramming
multiplier: 6 historical trade penalty implementation instances with strict timeline evaluations
validity_reason: Administrative procedures act and customs automated system update constraints remain stable across presidential administrations.
